sections.title: It’s never just one thing about your smile
sections.sub: Most people who ask us about a smile makeover don’t have a single problem. It’s a chip here, some staining there, one tooth slightly out of line. Small things that add up every time you look in the mirror.
items: Whitening toothpastes haven’t touched it. Coffee, tea and time have taken the brightness out of your smile.
Your front teeth have lost their shape over the years. Edges are uneven, and it shows in photos.
Nothing dramatic, but one or two teeth sit out of line, and it’s the first thing you see.
Spacing between your front teeth that whitening and bonding alone can’t fully solve.
You have a camera face. You know your angles. You’ve been doing this for years without realising why.
This has been on your list for years. You’re still waiting for the right time. There isn’t one. There’s just doing it.
sections.close: A smile makeover fixes all of the above with one joined-up plan: straightening, whitening, bonding and veneers sequenced properly, so every step builds towards the final result.

sections.title: One plan. Every treatment your smile needs. Nothing it doesn’t.
sections.text: A smile makeover isn’t a single procedure. It’s a sequence of treatments designed together, so the straightening, the shade and the shape all arrive at one finished result.

card.title: What is a smile makeover?
card.text: A smile makeover is a personalised combination of cosmetic treatments (typically clear aligners, professional whitening, composite bonding and porcelain veneers) planned as a single journey. At your consultation we take a 3D digital scan, design your new smile with you, and sequence only the treatments you actually need. Some makeovers are completed in a single visit; others begin with a short course of aligners before the cosmetic finishing. Either way, you see the plan, the timeline and the full cost before anything begins.

sections.title: From first scan to final reveal
items: We assess your teeth, listen to what you want to change, and take a 3D digital scan. You see a projected outcome before committing to anything.
Your dentist designs the combination and sequence of treatments, with the full cost agreed upfront. No surprises later.
Straightening first if needed, then whitening, then bonding or veneers, each stage building on the last.
The final shape, shade and symmetry, checked against the design you approved. Plus everything you need to keep it that way.
